summary: The change adds an archive-only adapter for planner fixtures, keeps repository size and credential checks in the packer, preserves the named fair-read case at one valid unit, and adds a deterministic regression for rejecting GNU-only tar flags.

evidence: The named case remains in tests/host/backup-ci-plan-commit_test.ts and still asserts a 12-read bound, the valid head read, and exactly one planned unit.
archiveFixtureBare uses POSIX tar creation on the local fixture surface while the hosted path retains the deterministic GNU tar default.
The new platform-boundary test deterministically rejects GNU-only flags and verifies the portable adapter ships the selected Git object, while pack custody scans remain non-injectable.
